audit_items.proof_trace: The close factor bypass is governed by two intentional exemptions: (1) a near-bad-debt bypass when collateral_total_value ≤ 1.01 × debts_total_value (L984-992), and (2) a small-debt bypass when the specific debt_value ≤ close_factor_bypass_min_value (L1006), with the latter explicitly documented at L1081. All three liquidation entry points (handle_liquidation, handle_debt_auto_deleverage, handle_collateral_auto_deleverage) call liquidation_inner which unconditionally invokes ensure_liquidate_borrow_allowed — no code path bypasses this check. The property assertion uses total_collateral_value as the comparand, but the code correctly uses debt_value (the USD value of the specific debt type being repaid), matching the design intent per code comment.
